name: Oxygen Cylinder Trolley
about:
n Oxygen Cylinder Trolley is a mobile trolley designed to safely transport oxygen cylinders within hospital premises. It ensures that patients receive oxygen wherever needed without carrying heavy cylinders manually. 
Main Uses: 
1. Patient Oxygen Supply: 
Used to deliver oxygen to patients in wards, ICU, emergency rooms, or during transport within the hospital.  
2. Safe Cylinder Handling: 
Prevents the risk of injury or cylinder damage while moving heavy oxygen cylinders.  
3. Emergency Use:
Quickly moves oxygen cylinders to critical areas such as emergency rooms, OT, or ICU in case of sudden patient need.  
4. Hospital Transport:Helps in transferring oxygen cylinders from storage areas to wards or OT without manual lifting. 
5. Multiple Cylinder Support:
Some trolleys are designed to carry one or more cylinders, with secure clamps to hold them in place.

name: Kick Bowl Bucket
about:
A Kick Bowl Bucket (also known as a kick bucket) is a stainless steel bowl fitted on a wheeled stand, mainly used in operation theatres and procedure rooms for collecting medical waste. 
Main Uses: 
1. Collection of Medical Waste: 
Used to collect used cotton, gauze pieces, swabs, and other disposable materials during surgical procedures. 
2. Operation Theatre Use: 
Placed near the operating table for easy disposal of contaminated items during surgery. 
3. Hands-Free Operation:
Designed with wheels so it can be moved easily by gently pushing (kicking) without touching by hand, maintaining sterility. 
4. Maintaining Cleanliness: 
Helps keep the surgical area clean and organized. 
5. Procedure Rooms & Dressing Rooms: 
Also used during minor procedures, wound dressing, and emergency treatments.

name: Wheel chair

wheelchair is a mobility assistive device essentially a chair with wheels designed to help people who cant walk independently or have limited ability to walk. It may be manual (pushed by a caregiver) or powered (electric) depending on the patients needs.

Large rear wheels (for manual self-propulsion or easy pushing)
Smaller front caster wheels
Brakes and footrests for safety and comfort

Reduces staff strain: Prevents injuries to healthcare workers during lifting or repositioning.

Infection control: Can be sanitized between uses to maintain hygiene.

Main Uses in Hospital:

Used to maintain privacy during examination, dressing, nursing procedures, and medical treatment.

Creates a temporary partition between patient beds in wards and ICUs.

name: Dressing Trolley

specifications.Function: For Storage and Transportation of Medical Dressings
specifications.Feature: Corrosion Resistant, Rust Proof, Easy to Clean

about:
A Hospital Dressing Trolley is a vital piece of medical furniture used for carrying and organizing dressing materials, instruments, and medications required during wound care and minor procedures. It enhances efficiency, cleanliness, and accessibility in patient care settings.
Key Features:
Durable Construction: Made from stainless steel or powder-coated metal, ensuring corrosion resistance and easy disinfection.
Multiple Shelves: Usually 23 spacious shelves for storing dressing kits, bandages, trays, and other supplies.
Smooth Mobility: Fitted with 4 swivel castors (typically two with brakes) for easy movement and stability.
Safety Rails: Guardrails on shelves to prevent items from falling during transport.
Optional Accessories:
Waste bins
Detachable bow
lsIV pole attachment
Drawers for additional storage
Robust Stainless Steel Construction
Engineered with high-quality 304 grade stainless steel, the dressing trolley is resistant to rust and corrosion. Its polished frame and durable build ensure longevity, even in demanding medical environments. The removable trays facilitate easy cleaning and maintenance, supporting hygienic practices in clinical settings.
Mobility and Practical Design
Fitted with swivel castor wheels and brakes, the trolley enables smooth and secure movement throughout hospitals or clinics. Guard rails and raised edges protect against accidental spills, making it an efficient solution for the storage and transport of medical dressings and related supplies.
Ready-to-Use and Customizable
This pre-assembled hospital dressing trolley is ready for immediate use upon delivery. Optional accessories such as basins and buckets can be added as required, enhancing its functionality. The standard-size, non-foldable design meets the everyday operational demands of modern healthcare environments.

name: Fowler Bed - Electric
about:
A Fowler bed is a specialized hospital bed that allows the patient to be positioned in a semi-upright sitting position (typically 4560 degrees), known as the Fowlers position. It is primarily used in medical settings for patient care, especially when rest, feeding, breathing assistance, or certain medical procedures require specific body alignment.
Key Features:
Adjustable Backrest: Mechanically or electronically adjustable to raise the upper body (head and back).
Knee Rest Adjustment: Allows for elevation of the knees to enhance circulation and reduce pressure on the lower back.
Manual or Electric Operation: Available in both manual (with cranks) or electric (with remote control or panel) models.
Frame Material: Made from powder-coated or stainless steel for durability and easy cleaning.
Mattress Platform: Typically made of perforated steel or ABS panels for ventilation and hygiene.
Side Rails: Collapsible or fixed safety side rails to prevent patient falls.
Wheels/Casters: Smooth-rolling, lockable wheels for easy movement and secure positioning.

name: Hospital Plain Bed
about: A hospital plain bed is a standard medical bed designed for patient care in hospitals, clinics, or home healthcare settings. It typically features a flat, adjustable frame made of durable metal, a firm mattress for patient support, and side rails for safety. Unlike advanced hospital beds, a plain bed usually does not have electronic adjustments but may include manual levers for raising the head or foot sections. It is often mounted on wheels for easy movement and has a minimalist design focused on basic patient comfort and care.

name: Attendant bed cum chair
about:
The Attendant Bed Cum Chair is a multi-functional piece of furniture designed specifically for hospital or home care environments. It serves as a comfortable chair for caregivers during the day and easily transforms into a compact bed at night, providing much-needed rest without taking up extra space.
Key Features:
2-in-1 Design: Functions both as a chair and a single bed, perfect for overnight stays.
Space-Saving: Ideal for rooms with limited space; folds back into a chair when not in use.
Sturdy Frame: Constructed with a durable metal or wooden frame for long-lasting use.
Comfortable Padding: Cushioned seat and mattress ensure comfort in both sitting and sleeping positions.
Easy Conversion: Quick and hassle-free transformation between chair and bed.
Mobility Options (if applicable): Equipped with smooth-rolling wheels for easy movement.
Washable Covers (if applicable): Upholstery comes with removable, washable fabric for hygiene maintenance.
Applications:
Hospitals and clinics
Home care settings
Patient attendant rooms
Guest or temporary sleeping arrangement

name: Blood Transfusion Chair
about:
The blood donation chair is a specially designed medical chair used for collecting blood, plasma, or platelets from donors in a safe, comfortable, and hygienic manner. It features an ergonomic, reclining design that supports the donor throughout the procedure while ensuring easy access for healthcare professionals.
Key Features:
Adjustable Reclining Backrest: Enables semi-reclined or fully reclined positions to improve donor comfort and prevent fainting or hypotension.
Cushioned Armrests: Dual padded armrests are fully adjustable in height and angle to accommodate left or right arm donations.
Sturdy Frame: Constructed with a high-strength steel or aluminum frame for durability and stability, supporting various body types.
Comfortable Upholstery: High-density foam with antimicrobial, easy-to-clean synthetic leather or vinyl covering.
Safety and Stability: Anti-slip rubber feet or lockable caster wheels ensure the chair stays securely in place.
Weight Capacity: Typically supports up to 150200 kg (330440 lbs).
Optional Features:
IV pole attachment
Paper roll holder for hygiene sheets
Foldable design for mobile blood donation units
Integrated storage tray for medical tools

name: Over Bed Table - ABS

Key Features:
Adjustable Height: Easily raised or lowered to accommodate different bed heights and patient needs.
Tilting Surface (optional): Some models feature a tilting tabletop for reading or writing comfort.
Smooth-Rolling Casters: Equipped with wheels for easy movement and positioning, often with locking mechanisms for stability.
Durable Surface: Made from easy-to-clean materials such as laminated wood or plastic.
Stable Base: Designed to fit under most hospital beds for stability and support.
Overbed tables enhance patient comfort and independence, making daily activities more accessible while in bed.

about:

Key Features:
Sturdy Frame: Constructed from high-quality steel or aluminum for durability and long-term use.

name: Spine Board
about:
A spine board, also known as a backboard or spinal board, is a rigid patient handling device used primarily for the immobilization and safe transport of individuals with suspected spinal, neck, or limb injuries. Commonly used in emergency medical services (EMS), ambulances, hospitals, and rescue operations, the spine board helps prevent further injury during movement.
Key Features:
Durable Construction: Made from high-strength plastic or composite materials that are lightweight, waterproof, and easy to clean.
Radiolucent Design: Allows for X-rays and imaging without needing to move the patient.
Multiple Handholds: Integrated handles on all sides enable secure grip and easy lifting by multiple responders.
Strap Compatibility: Equipped with multiple slots for securing patient safety straps or head immobilizers.
Weight Capacity: Designed to support high weight limits for use with adult and pediatric patients.
The spine board is essential for trauma care, providing critical support and immobilization to minimize the risk of spinal cord damage during rescue and transport

name: Four Fold Stretcher
about:
A Four-Fold Stretcher is a portable, collapsible patient transport device used in emergency rescue, ambulances, hospitals, and disaster response. Designed to be lightweight and compact, it can be folded into four parts for easy storage and transport, making it ideal for use in confined or challenging environments.
Key Features:
Four-Fold Design: Folds lengthwise and widthwise into a compact size for convenient storage and portability.
Durable Frame: Made from high-strength aluminum alloy or stainless steel, ensuring stability and long-lasting performance.
Reinforced Fabric: Heavy-duty, waterproof, and fire-resistant canvas or PVC material for patient comfort and easy cleaning.
Safety Straps: Equipped with patient securing straps to ensure safe and secure transport.
Rubber Grips: Anti-slip handles for a firm grip during lifting and carrying.
Lightweight and Portable: Easy to deploy and ideal for emergency evacuations or remote locations.
The Four-Fold Stretcher is an essential tool for first responders and emergency teams, offering reliable patient transport in critical situations

name: Scoop Stretcher
about:
A scoop stretcher, also known as a clamshell stretcher, is a specially designed patient transport device used to safely lift, move, and transfer injured or immobilized patients without unnecessary movement of the spine or body. It consists of two interlocking longitudinal halves that can be separated and positioned on either side of the patient, then gently scooped together, minimizing the need for rolling or lifting.
Key Features:
Split Design: Two-part construction allows placement under the patient without excessive handling.
Lightweight & Durable: Made from high-strength aluminum or polymer for easy portability and long-term use.
Adjustable Length: Adapts to different patient heights for optimal support.
Radiolucent Material: Allows X-rays and imaging without removing the patient from the stretcher.
Safety Locks & Straps: Ensures patient stability during transport.
Applications in Hospitals:
Ideal for emergency departments, trauma care, and patient transfers where spinal precautions are necessary. Commonly used in combination with spine boards and cervical collars to ensure maximum safety during handling.
